description:
Global DevOps Bot config template. Copy to global-bot-token.json and fill in real values.

Fields:
- gitcode_api_token: GitCode bot PAT (write operations: create/close/comment issues)
- github_bot_token: GitHub bot PAT (write operations: create/close/comment issues)
- github_bot_username: GitHub bot account username (for collaborator management)
- gitcode_oauth_client_id/secret/redirect_uri: GitCode OAuth login credentials (loaded to meta table on first run; redirect_uri auto-inferred if empty)
- github_oauth_client_id/secret/redirect_uri: GitHub OAuth login credentials (loaded to meta table on first run; redirect_uri auto-inferred if empty)
- bot_usernames: GitCode bot usernames for self-comment detection (array, can be auto-fetched via /api/v5/user)
- webhook_url: GitCode webhook callback URL (e.g. https://your-domain/webhook/gitcode)
- gitcode_webhook_token: GitCode webhook secret for signature verification (also accepted as field name 'webhook_secret')

Issue #345: On startup, all fields are migrated from this file to DB meta table.
DB becomes the authority at runtime; this file is preserved as read-only migration source.
Admin config center (PUT /api/admin/config) writes to DB directly, not this file.
